title: Chana Masala
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 30 seconds until fragrant
2. Add diced onions and sauté for 8-10 minutes until golden brown, stirring occasionally
3. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant
4. Add turmeric, coriander, chili powder, and half the garam masala. Stir for 30 seconds
5. Pour in the pureed tomatoes and cook for 5-7 minutes until oil separates from the masala
6. Add the drained chickpeas and water. Stir well to coat chickpeas with the masala
7. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally
8. Using the back of a spoon, gently mash some chickpeas to thicken the gravy
9. Add remaining garam masala, salt, and lemon juice. Stir and cook for 2 more minutes
10. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with basmati rice or naan bread

title: Classic Basil Pesto Pasta
instructions:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Toast pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until golden
3. In a food processor, combine basil, pine nuts, and garlic. Pulse until coarsely chopped
4. With the processor running, slowly drizzle in the olive oil until smooth
5. Transfer pesto to a bowl and stir in the Parmesan, salt, and pepper
6. Cook pasta until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining
7. Drain pasta and return to the pot. Add pesto and 2 tbsp pasta water
8. Toss until pasta is evenly coated, adding more water if needed
9. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed
10. Serve immediately with fresh basil and extra Parmesan

title: Tacos al Pastor
instructions:
1. Rehydrate guajillo chiles in hot water for 15 minutes until soft
2. Blend chiles, chipotle, garlic, pineapple juice, vinegar, cumin, oregano, cloves, and salt until smooth
3. Pour marinade over sliced pork and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
4. Preheat a cast iron skillet to medium-high heat
5. Cook pork in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until charred
6. Grill pineapple slices for 2-3 minutes per side until caramelized
7. Chop the pineapple into small pieces
8. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side
9. Chop the cooked pork into small pieces
10. Assemble tacos with pork, pineapple, onion, cilantro, and lime

title: Kung Pao Chicken
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, and cornstarch for 15 minutes
2. Mix remaining soy sauce, vinegar, hoisin, sugar, and sesame oil for the sauce
3. Heat wok over high heat until smoking. Add 1 tbsp oil
4. Stir-fry chicken for 4-5 minutes until cooked. Remove and set aside
5. Add remaining oil. Stir-fry dried chiles and peppercorns for 30 seconds
6. Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds
7. Add bell pepper and white parts of green onions. Cook for 2 minutes
8. Return chicken to wok. Pour in the sauce
9. Toss for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens
10. Add peanuts and green onion tops. Serve over rice

title: Classic Smash Burger
instructions:
1. Mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, and relish for burger sauce
2. Divide beef into 4 portions (4 oz each). Form into loose balls
3. Heat cast iron skillet over high heat for 5 minutes
4. Butter and toast buns in a separate pan until golden
5. Season beef balls with salt and pepper
6. Place on hot skillet and smash flat with spatula
7. Cook for 2-3 minutes until edges are crispy
8. Flip patties and add cheese. Cook 1 minute more
9. Remove from heat when cheese melts
10. Spread sauce on buns. Layer lettuce, tomato, patty, pickles, and onion

title: Authentic Pad Thai
instructions:
1. Soak rice noodles in room temperature water for 30-45 minutes. Drain
2. Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, sugar, vinegar, and chili flakes for sauce
3. Heat 1 tbsp oil in wok over high heat. Sear shrimp for 1 minute per side
4. Remove shrimp and set aside
5. Add remaining oil. Stir-fry garlic for 15 seconds
6. Push garlic aside. Add eggs and scramble into small pieces
7. Add noodles and sauce. Toss for 2-3 minutes until noodles are cooked
8. Add shrimp, half the bean sprouts, and green onions. Toss for 1 minute
9. Remove from heat. Add half the peanuts
10. Serve topped with remaining sprouts, peanuts, cilantro, and lime

title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1.5 lbs beef sirloin, sliced into thin strips
instructions:
1. Season beef strips with salt, pepper, and paprika. Let rest for 10 minutes
2. Cook egg noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat. Sear beef in batches for 2 minutes per side
4. Remove beef and set aside. Reduce heat to medium
5. Add butter to the skillet. Sauté onions for 5 minutes until softened
6. Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes until golden brown
7. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
8. Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir for 1 minute
9. Pour in beef broth, Worcestershire, and mustard. Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened
10. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream and beef. Serve over egg noodles with parsley

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions:
1. Mix yogurt, lemon juice, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric, and cumin. Marinate chicken for 2 hours
2. Thread chicken onto skewers. Grill or broil for 4 minutes per side until charred
3. Heat butter and oil in a large pan over medium heat
4. Sauté onions for 8 minutes until golden brown
5. Add garlic and ginger, cook for 2 minutes until fragrant
6. Add remaining garam masala, paprika, and salt. Stir for 30 seconds
7. Pour in crushed tomatoes. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally
8. Reduce heat to low. Stir in heavy cream until well combined
9. Add grilled chicken pieces. Simmer for 10 minutes in the sauce
10. Garnish with fresh cilantro. Serve with basmati rice or naan

title: Greek Moussaka
instructions:
1. Salt eggplant slices and let drain for 30 minutes. Pat dry and brush with olive oil
2. Roast eggplant at 400°F for 20 minutes until golden. Set aside
3. Brown ground lamb in a large skillet, breaking it up. Drain excess fat
4. Add onion and cook for 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more
5. Pour in tomatoes, wine, cinnamon, and allspice. Simmer for 20 minutes until thickened
6. For béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, cook 2 minutes. Gradually add milk
7. Cook béchamel until thick, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat
8. Whisk in Parmesan, egg yolks, and nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper
9. Layer half the eggplant, all the meat, remaining eggplant, then béchamel in a 9x13 pan
10. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest 15 minutes before serving

title: Teriyaki Glazed Salmon
instructions:
1. Combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, brown sugar, honey, garlic, and ginger in a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes until slightly thickened
3. Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels. Season lightly with salt
4. Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Place salmon skin-side up and cook for 3 minutes until golden
6. Flip salmon and cook for 2 minutes more
7. Pour half the teriyaki sauce over the salmon
8. Continue cooking for 2-3 minutes, basting with sauce until salmon is cooked through
9. Remove from heat. Drizzle with remaining sauce
10. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Serve with steamed rice

title: Beef Bourguignon
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions:
1. Pat beef dry and season generously with salt and pepper
2. Cook bacon in a Dutch oven until crispy. Remove and set aside
3. Brown beef in batches in bacon fat, about 3 minutes per side. Set aside
4. Sauté carrots and pearl onions for 5 minutes. Remove and set aside
5. Add garlic and tomato paste, cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle with flour
6. Pour in wine and broth, scraping up browned bits from the bottom
7. Return beef and bacon to pot. Add bouquet garni. Bring to a boil
8. Cover and braise in 325°F oven for 2 hours until beef is tender
9. Sauté mushrooms in butter. Add to stew with reserved vegetables
10. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes to thicken. Garnish with parsley and serve

title: Korean Bibimbap
instructions:
1. Marinate beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, garlic, and sugar for 15 minutes
2. Season each vegetable separately with a pinch of salt and sesame oil
3. Sauté beef in a hot pan for 2-3 minutes until cooked. Set aside
4. Prepare sauce: mix gochujang, remaining soy sauce, sesame oil, and 1 tbsp water
5. Fry eggs sunny-side up, keeping yolks runny
6. Divide hot rice among 4 bowls
7. Arrange beef and vegetables in sections on top of rice
8. Place a fried egg in the center of each bowl
9. Drizzle with gochujang sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds
10. Serve with kimchi. Mix everything together before eating

title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
instructions:
1. Season lamb with cumin, cinnamon, ginger, salt, and pepper
2. Heat oil in a tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat
3. Brown lamb in batches, about 4 minutes per batch. Set aside
4. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute
5. Bloom saffron in 2 tbsp warm water for 5 minutes
6. Return lamb to pot. Add broth, saffron with liquid, and honey
7. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 1 hour
8. Add chickpeas, apricots, and dates. Continue cooking for 30 minutes
9. The sauce should be thick and lamb very tender. Adjust seasoning
10. Top with toasted almonds and fresh cilantro. Serve with couscous

title: Vietnamese Pho
instructions:
1. Char onion and ginger under broiler for 10 minutes until blackened
2. Toast star anise, cloves, cinnamon, and coriander in a dry pan until fragrant
3. Bring 4 quarts water to boil. Add bones and brisket, boil for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse
4. Return bones and brisket to pot with fresh water. Add charred onion and ginger
5. Add toasted spices. Simmer for 1.5 hours, skimming occasionally
6. Remove brisket when tender (about 40 minutes). Slice thin and set aside
7. Strain broth through fine mesh. Season with fish sauce and sugar
8. Cook rice noodles according to package. Divide among bowls
9. Top with sliced brisket. Ladle hot broth over noodles
10. Serve with bean sprouts, basil, cilantro, lime, hoisin, and sriracha

title: Spanish Seafood Paella
instructions:
1. Bloom saffron in warm stock for 10 minutes
2. Heat oil in a 15-inch paella pan or wide skillet over medium-high heat
3. Sear shrimp for 1 minute per side. Remove and set aside
4. Sauté calamari for 2 minutes. Remove and set aside
5. Cook onion and bell pepper for 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute
6. Add tomatoes and paprika. Cook for 3 minutes until slightly dry
7. Pour in wine and let reduce by half. Add rice and stir to coat
8. Pour in saffron stock. Distribute evenly and do not stir from this point
9. Nestle mussels into rice. Cook for 15 minutes until rice absorbs most liquid
10. Add shrimp, calamari, and peas. Cook 5 more minutes. Let rest, then serve with lemon

title: Lebanese Falafel
instructions:
1. Drain soaked chickpeas thoroughly. Do not use canned chickpeas
2. Add chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, and cilantro to food processor
3. Pulse until finely ground but not pureed. Scrape down sides frequently
4. Add cumin, coriander, cayenne, and salt. Pulse to combine
5. Transfer to bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour
6. Mix in baking powder just before frying
7. Form mixture into 1.5-inch balls or patties
8. Heat 3 inches of oil to 350°F in a deep pot
9. Fry falafel in batches for 3-4 minutes until deep golden brown
10. Drain on paper towels. Serve in pita with tahini, pickles, and fresh vegetables

title: Butter Chicken
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, turmeric, and cumin for 2 hours
2. Grill or pan-fry marinated chicken until charred. Set aside
3. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large pan over medium heat
4. Add onion puree and cook for 5 minutes until golden
5. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes
6. Pour in tomato puree. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally
7. Reduce heat to low. Add remaining butter and cream. Stir until combined
8. Add grilled chicken pieces. Simmer for 10 minutes in the sauce
9. Crush kasuri methi between palms and add to curry. Add sugar and salt
10. Garnish with cream swirl and cilantro. Serve with naan or rice

title: Tonkotsu Ramen
instructions:
1. Prepare soft-boiled eggs: cook for 6.5 minutes, then ice bath. Peel and marinate in soy sauce
2. Heat tonkotsu broth in a large pot over medium heat
3. Whisk in miso paste until dissolved. Add soy sauce and mirin
4. Pan-fry chashu slices until caramelized on edges. Set aside
5. Blanch bean sprouts in boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain
6. Cook ramen noodles according to package (usually 2-3 minutes). Drain well
7. Divide noodles among 4 deep bowls
8. Ladle hot broth over noodles
9. Arrange chashu, halved egg, nori, sprouts, and bamboo shoots on top
10. Drizzle with sesame oil and chili oil. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds

title: Classic Caesar Salad
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions:
1. Wash and dry romaine lettuce. Tear into bite-sized pieces
2. For croutons: cube bread, toss with olive oil, bake at 375°F for 10 minutes
3. Mash anchovy fillets and garlic into a paste using the back of a knife
4. Transfer paste to a large bowl. Whisk in egg yolk
5. Add lemon juice, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce. Whisk to combine
6. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking constantly until emulsified
7. Season dressing with salt and generous black pepper
8. Add romaine to bowl with dressing. Toss to coat evenly
9. Add grated Parmesan and croutons. Toss gently
10. Divide among plates. Top with Parmesan shavings and extra pepper

title: Margherita Pizza
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 500°F (or as high as it goes) with pizza stone for 1 hour
2. Make sauce: blend tomatoes with garlic, salt, and 1 tbsp olive oil
3. Let dough come to room temperature for 30 minutes
4. Stretch dough on floured surface to 12-inch round
5. Transfer to semolina-dusted pizza peel or inverted baking sheet
6. Spread thin layer of sauce, leaving 1-inch border
7. Arrange mozzarella slices evenly over sauce
8. Slide pizza onto hot stone. Bake for 8-10 minutes until crust is charred
9. Remove from oven. Top with fresh basil leaves
10. Drizzle with remaining olive oil and red pepper flakes. Slice and serve immediately

title: Fish and Chips
instructions:
1. Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch thick chips. Soak in cold water for 30 minutes
2. Drain potatoes and pat completely dry with paper towels
3. Heat oil to 325°F. Blanch chips for 5 minutes until soft but not colored. Drain
4. Make batter: whisk flour, baking powder, salt, and beer until smooth
5. Increase oil temperature to 375°F
6. Pat fish fillets dry. Season with salt
7. Dip fish in batter, letting excess drip off
8. Fry fish for 5-6 minutes until golden and cooked through. Drain on rack
9. Fry blanched chips a second time for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy
10. Season chips with salt. Serve with fish, malt vinegar, tartar sauce, and lemon

title: Chicken Shawarma
instructions:
1. Mix olive oil, garlic, cumin, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, cayenne, and lemon juice
2. Coat chicken thighs in marinade. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight
3. Make sauce: whisk yogurt, tahini, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and pinch of salt
4. Preheat grill or cast iron pan to high heat
5. Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through
6. Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice into thin strips
7. Warm pita bread on the grill for 30 seconds per side
8. Spread tahini sauce on pita
9. Layer chicken, tomatoes, cucumber, and pickled turnips
10. Drizzle with extra sauce and garnish with parsley. Roll and serve
